cold_open: Three weeks of division games are done. Week 4 sends every team across the line for the first time this season: a 2013 title-game rematch, a series dead even at 7–7, and an eleven-game lead that has never been wider.

notes.Evan|Kevin Swanson: Evan beat Swanson for the 2013 title. Swanson took their last meeting, 99.05–59.15 in Week 16 last year, and leads 16–15 over 31 games — one of them decided by 0.02 points.
notes.Dominic|Shawn: Shawn once beat Dominic five straight times, 2012 to 2016. Dominic now has five straight of his own, the last by 52.57 points, and leads the series 13–11.
notes.Douglas|Thomas: Doug once led this series by six and still holds a 9–5 edge. But Tom has won the last two, and owns its biggest blowout — 69.06 points in 2022.
notes.Eric|Steve Swanson: Only the sixth meeting, and lately it has been all Eric: three straight, the last 86.64–47.37 in Week 15 last year. Steve opened this young series 2–0.
notes.Brian Clark|Jeff: Fourteen games, dead even at 7–7. Clark once ran off four straight and led by four; Jeff has taken three of the last five, and owns the biggest blowout — 84.17 points in 2023.
notes.Fadi|Kevin O'Boyle: Twenty-seven meetings since 2002, and O'Boyle leads 19–8, the widest the gap has ever been. He once won six straight, and took their closest game by 0.71 points in 2015.

history_lines.text: Kevin O'Boyle sets the Week 4 standard
Kevin Swanson goes big the same week

milestone.label: Steve Swanson · Points to 22,500
milestone.text: Steve Swanson is 120.82 points from 22,500 for his career. In the all-time wins race, Kevin Swanson leads Brian Clark 194–192.

kicker: All six are cross-division games, the first of the 2026 season.
